name: Patient EOB Model
description: This model is for patient claims data and is based on CPCDS

attributes.name: Member ID
attributes.description: Identifier for a member assigned by the Payer.  If members receive ID cards, that is the identifier that should be provided.

attributes.name: Unique Member ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for a member assigned by the Payer.

attributes.name: Member Identifier Type
attributes.description: Identifies the type of identifier payers and providers assign to patients

attributes.name: Date of Birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the member.

attributes.name: Date of Death
attributes.description: Date of death of the member.

attributes.name: Deceased Flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating if the member is deceased

attributes.name: Birth Sex
attributes.description: The gender of the member at birth.

attributes.name: Race Code
attributes.description: The race of the member.

attributes.name: Ethnicity
attributes.description: The ethnicity of the member.

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: The city for the member's primary address

attributes.name: County
attributes.description: 125	County	The county for the member's primary address.

attributes.name: State
attributes.description: The state for the member's primary address.

attributes.name: Country
attributes.description: The country for the member's primary address.

attributes.name: Postal Code
attributes.description: This represents the member's 5 digit zip code.

attributes.name: Address start date
attributes.description: Member address start date

attributes.name: Address end date
attributes.description: member address end date

attributes.name: telecom system
attributes.description: Telecommunications form for contact point.

attributes.name: Telecom Use
attributes.description: Purpose of this contact point - home, mobile, work, etc

attributes.name: Street address
attributes.description: Street name, number, direction & P.O. Box etc.

attributes.name: Primary language
attributes.description: A language which may be used to communicate with the patient about his or her health

attributes.name: Coverage data class
attributes.description: A collection representing a patient's insurance coverage and benefit information.

attributes.name: Coverage element
attributes.description: A single Coverage element of the Coverage Data Class.

attributes.name: Subscriber ID
attributes.description: The identifier assigned by the Payer on the subscriber's ID card.

attributes.name: Coverage Type
attributes.description: Identifies if the coverage is PPO, HMO, POS, etc.

attributes.name: Coverage Status
attributes.description: Identifies the status of the coverage information (default: active).

attributes.name: Start Date
attributes.description: Date that the contract became effective.

attributes.name: End Date
attributes.description: Date that the contract was terminated or coverage changed

attributes.name: Group ID
attributes.description: Employer account identifier.

attributes.name: Group Name
attributes.description: Name of the Employer Account.

attributes.name: Plan Identifier
attributes.description: Business concept used by a health plan to describe its benefit offerings.

attributes.name: Plan Name
attributes.description: Name of the health plan benefit offering assigned to the Plan Identifier.

attributes.name: Payer Identifier
attributes.description: Issuer of the Policy

attributes.name: Other Payer Name
attributes.description: Identifies another payer who applied benefits for the service on another claim

attributes.name: Relationship to Subscriber
attributes.description: Relationship of the member to the person insured (subscriber).

attributes.name: Claim payer Name
attributes.description: Name of the payer responsible for the claim

attributes.name: Claim DRG Version
attributes.description:
32 - Version of the DRG codes assigned for inpatient facility claims.
33- Claim diagnosis related group (DRG) code value
113 - Name of the DRG grouper assigned; i.e., MS-DRG, AP-DRG or APR-DRG

attributes.name: Claim Service Start Date
attributes.description:
90 - Date on which services began.  UB04 (Form Locator 45).
118 - Date on which services began. Located on CMS 1500 (Form Locator 24A)

attributes.name: Statement Thru Date
attributes.description: On Institutional claims, the last day on the billing statement covering services rendered to the beneficiary (i.e. 'Statement Covers Thru Date’)  On Professional and Non-Clinician claims, the latest of any of the line-item level dates.

attributes.name: Procedure Code Type
attributes.description: Indicates if the inpatient institutional procedure (ICD-PCS) is the principal procedure or another procedure

attributes.name: Adjudication Date
attributes.description: Date the claim was adjudicated

attributes.name: Member Discharge Date
attributes.description: Date the beneficiary was discharged from the facility, or died. Matches the Statement Thru Date. When there is a discharge date, the Patient Discharge Status Code indicates the final disposition of the patient after discharge.

attributes.name: Claim Primary Payer Identifier
attributes.description: Identifies the primary payer.  For use only on secondary claims.

attributes.name: Claim Sub Type
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the claim.

attributes.name: Patient Discharge Status Code
attributes.description: Patient’s status as of the discharge date for a facility stay. Information located on UB04 (Form Locator 17).

attributes.name: Claim Payer Identifier
attributes.description: The identifier assigned to the Operating Surgeon.

attributes.name: Medical Record Number
attributes.description: Provider submitted information that can be included on the claim.

attributes.name: Claim Identifier Type
attributes.description: Indicates that the claim identifier is that assigned by a payer for a claim received from a provider or subscriber.

attributes.name: Claim Processing Status Code
attributes.description: Claim processing status code

attributes.name: Claim Bill Facility Type Code
attributes.description: UB04 (Form Locator 4) type of bill code provides specific information for payer purposes. The first digit of the three-digit number denotes the type of facility.

attributes.name: Claim Adjusted from Identifier
attributes.description: If the current claim represents a claim that has been adjusted and was given a prior claim number, this field represents the prior claim number

attributes.name: Claim Adjusted to Identifier
attributes.description: If the current claim has been adjusted; i.e., replaced by or merged to another claim number, this data element represents that new number.

attributes.name: Claim Adjusted Relationship
attributes.description: The nature of the claim adjustment

attributes.name: Claim Received Date
attributes.description: The date the claim was received by the payer.

attributes.name: Claim Payment Status Code
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim was paid or denied.

attributes.name: Claim Paid Date
attributes.description: The date the claim was paid.

attributes.name: Claim Discount Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the discount.

attributes.name: Claim Service Classification Type Code
attributes.description: UB04 (Form Locator 4) type of bill code provides specific information for payer purposes. The second digit classifies the type of care (service classification) being billed.

attributes.name: Patient Account Number
attributes.description: Provider submitted information that can be included on the claim.

attributes.name: Claim Payee Type Code
attributes.description: Identifies the type of recipient of the adjudication amount; i.e., provider, subscriber, beneficiary or another recipient

attributes.name: Claim Inpatient Source Admission Code
attributes.description: Identifies the place where the patient was identified as needing admission to a facility. This is a two position code mapped from the standard values for the UB-04 Source of Admission code (FL-15).

attributes.name: Member Admission Date
attributes.description: The date corresponding with admission of the beneficiary to a facility and the onset of services. May precede the Statement From Date if this claim is for a beneficiary who has been continuously under care.

attributes.name: Claim Payment Denial Code
attributes.description: Reason codes used to interpret the Non-Covered Amount that are provided to the Provider

attributes.name: Claim Service End Date
attributes.description: 119	Claim Service End Date	Date on which services ended. Located on CMS 1500 (Form Locator 24A)

attributes.name: Claim Type Code
attributes.description: Specifies the type of claim. (e.g., inpatient institutional, outpatient institutional, physician, etc.).

attributes.name: Payer Claim Unique Identifier
attributes.description: 35	Payer Claim Unique Identifier	Identifier assigned by a payer for a claim received from a provider or subscriber. It is not the same identifier as that assigned by a provider.

attributes.name: Adjudication Amount Type
attributes.description: Describes the various amount fields used when payers receive and adjudicate a claim

attributes.name: Claim Inpatient Admission Type Code
attributes.description: Priority of the admission. Information located on (UB04 Form Locator 14). For example, an admission type of elective indicates that the patient's condition permitted time for medical services to be scheduled.

attributes.name: Claim Frequency Code
attributes.description: UB04 (Form Locator 4) type of bill code provides specific information for payer purposes. The third digit identifies the frequency of the bill for a specific course of treatment or inpatient confinement.

attributes.name: Claim Payee
attributes.description: Recipient reference.

attributes.name: Total Amount
attributes.description: Total amount for each category (i.e., submitted, eligible, etc.)

attributes.name: Statement From Date
attributes.description: On Institutional claims, the first day on the billing statement covering services rendered to the beneficiary (i.e. 'Statement Covers From Date’).  On Professional and Non-Clinician claims, Earliest of any of the line-item level dates. It is almost always the same as Claim Service End Date except for DME claims - where some services are billed in advance.

attributes.name: claim total submitted amount
attributes.description: Amount submitted by the provider for reimbursement of health care services. This amount includes non-covered services.

attributes.name: claim total allowed amount
attributes.description: The contracted reimbursable amount for covered medical services or supplies or amount reflecting local methodology for non-contracted providers. Allowed amount should not include any COB adjustment. That is, the Allowed amount on a claim should be the same when the Plan is primary or secondary.

attributes.name: Amount Paid by Patient
attributes.description: The amount paid by the member at the point of service.

attributes.name: Claim Amount Paid to Provider
attributes.description: The amount paid to the provider.

attributes.name: Member Reimbursement
attributes.description: The amount paid to the member.

attributes.name: Claim Payment Amount
attributes.description: The amount sent to the payee from the health plan. This amount is to exclude any member cost sharing.  It should include the total of member and provider payments.

attributes.name: Claim Non-covered Amount
attributes.description: The portion of the cost of this service that was deemed not eligible by the insurer because the service or member was not covered by the subscriber contract.

attributes.name: Member Paid Deductible
attributes.description: The portion of this service that the member must pay which is applied to the total period deductible. Deductibles are usually applied over a specific time period, such as per calendar year, per benefit period.

attributes.name: Co-insurance Liability Amount
attributes.description: The amount the insured individual pays, as a set percentage of the cost of covered medical services, as an out-of-pocket payment to the provider. Example: Insured pays 20% and the insurer pays 80%.

attributes.name: Copay Amount
attributes.description: Amount an insured individual pays directly to a provider at the time the services or supplies are rendered. Usually, a copay will be a fixed amount per service, such as $15.00 per office visit.

attributes.name: Member Liability
attributes.description: The amount of the member's liability.

attributes.name: Claim Other Payer Paid Amount
attributes.description: The reduction in the payment amount to reflect the current carrier as a secondary, teritary, etc, payer.  May be multiple occurrences if the current carrier is a teritary, etc. carrier.

attributes.name: Claim Use
attributes.description: A code to indicate whether the nature of the request is: to request adjudication of products and services previously rendered; or requesting authorization and adjudication for provision in the future; or requesting the non-binding adjudication of the listed products and services which could be provided in the future.

attributes.name: Service Date
attributes.description:
90 - Date on which services began.  UB04 (Form Locator 45).

118 - Date on which services began. Located on CMS 1500 (Form Locator 24A)

attributes.name: Line Number
attributes.description: Line identification number that represents the number assigned in a source system for identification and processing.

attributes.name: Service to Date
attributes.description: Date on which services ended. Located on CMS 1500 (Form Locator 24A)

attributes.name: Type of Service
attributes.description: High level classification of services into logical grouping.

attributes.name: Place of Service Code
attributes.description: Code indicating the location, such as inpatient, outpatient facility, office, or home health agency, where this service was performed.

attributes.name: Revenue Center Code
attributes.description: Code used on the UB-04 (Form Locator 42) to identify a specific accommodation, ancillary service, or billing calculation related to the service being billed.

attributes.name: Allowed Number of Units
attributes.description: The quantity of units, times, days, visits, services, or treatments allowed for the service described by the HCPCS code, revenue code or procedure code, submitted by the provider.

attributes.name: National Drug Code
attributes.description: National Drug Code (NDC), or if the prescription is a compound, the value 'Compound'

attributes.name: Compound Code
attributes.description: The code indicating whether or not the prescription is a compound.  NCPDP field # 406-D6

attributes.name: Quantity Dispensed
attributes.description: Quantity dispensed for the drug.

attributes.name: Quantity Qualifier Code
attributes.description: The unit of measurement for the drug. (gram, ml, etc.).

attributes.name: Benefit Payment Status
attributes.description: Indicates the in network or out of network payment status of the claim.

attributes.name: Line Payment Denial Code
attributes.description: Reason codes used to interpret the Non-Covered Amount that are provided to the Provider

attributes.name: Payment member explanation
attributes.description: Payment explanation to a member on an EOB

attributes.name: Line Noncovered Amount
attributes.description:
Medical: The portion of the cost of this service that was deemed not eligible by the insurer because the service or member was not covered by the subscriber contract.

Pharmacy: Non-Covered Amount represents the NCPDP financial response field Amount Exceeding Periodic Benefit Maximum.

attributes.name: Line Member Reimbursement
attributes.description: The amount paid to the member.

attributes.name: Line Payment Amount
attributes.description: The amount sent to the payee from the health plan. This amount is to exclude any member cost sharing.  It should include the total of member and provider payments.

attributes.name: Line Discount Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the discount.

attributes.name: Line Amount Paid by Patient
attributes.description:
Medical: The amount paid by the member at the point of service.

Pharmacy: Amount that is calculated by the processor and returned to the pharmacy as the total amount to be paid by the patient to the pharmacy; the patient’s total cost share, including copayments, amounts applied to deductible, over maximum amounts, penalties, etc

attributes.name: Drug Cost
attributes.description: Price paid for the drug excluding mfr discounts.  It is the sum of the following components:ingredient cost, dispensing fee, sales tax, and vaccine administration fee.

attributes.name: Line Allowed Amount
attributes.description: The contracted reimbursable amount for covered medical services or supplies or amount reflecting local methodology for noncontracted providers. Allowed  amount should not include any COB adjustment. That is, the Allowed amount on a claim should be the same when the Plan is primary or secondary.

attributes.name: Line Amount Paid to Provider
attributes.description: The amount paid to the provider.

attributes.name: Line Patient Deductible
attributes.description: The contracted reimbursable amount for covered medical services or supplies or amount reflecting local methodology for noncontracted providers.

attributes.name: Line Other Payer Paid Amount
attributes.description: The reduction in the payment amount to reflect the current carrier as a secondary, tertiary, etc, payer.  May be multiple occurrences if the current carrier is a tertiary, etc. carrier.

attributes.name: Line Coinsurance Amount
attributes.description:
Medical: The amount the insured individual pays, as a set percentage of the cost of covered medical services, as an out-of-pocket payment to the provider. Example: Insured pays 20% and the insurer pays 80%.
Pharmacy: Amount to be collected from a patient that is included in the Patient Pay Amount that is due to a per prescription copay or coinsurance.

attributes.name: Line Submitted Amount
attributes.description: Amount submitted by the provider for reimbursement of health care services. This amount includes non-covered services.

attributes.name: Line Member Liability Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the member's liability.

attributes.name: Line Copay Amount
attributes.description:
Medical: Amount an insured individual pays directly to a provider at the time the services or supplies are rendered. Usually, a copay will be a fixed amount per service, such as $15.00 per office visit.
Pharmacy: Amount to be collected from a patient that is included in the Patient Pay Amount that is due to a per prescription copay or coinsurance.

attributes.name: Line Procedure Code
attributes.description: Medical procedure a patient received from a health care provider. Current coding methods include: CPT-4 and HCFA Common Procedure Coding System Level II - (HCPCSII).  Health Insurance Prospective Payment System (HIPPS) rate codes represent specific sets of patient characteristics (or case-mix groups) health insurers use to make payment determinations under several prospective payment systems

attributes.name: Line Procedure Code Modifier
attributes.description: Modifier(s) for the procedure represented on this line. Identifies special circumstances related to the performance of the service.

attributes.name: Claim Diagnosis data class
attributes.description: A collection representing the diagnoses associated with a claim, including admitting, principal, and secondary diagnoses.

attributes.name: Claim Diagnosis element
attributes.description: A single Diagnosis element of the Claim Diagnosis Data Class.

attributes.name: Diagnosis Code
attributes.description:
21- ICD-10-CM code describing the condition chiefly responsible for a patient's admission to a facility. It may be different from the principal diagnosis, which is the diagnosis assigned after evaluation. Decimals will be included.

22 - The member's principal condition treated during this service. This may or may not be different from the admitting diagnosis. Decimals will be included.

23 - Additional diagnosis identified for this member. Decimals will be included.

attributes.name: E code Indicator
attributes.description: This is any valid ICD-10 Diagnosis code in the range V00.* through Y99.*

attributes.name: Present on Admission Indicator
attributes.description: Used to capture whether a diagnosis was present at time of a patient's admission. This is used to group diagnoses into the proper DRG for all claims involving inpatient admissions to general acute care facilities.

attributes.name: Diagnosis Type
attributes.description: Indicates if the diagnosis is admitting, principal, other, an external cause of injury or secondary

attributes.name: Procedure Claim Line
attributes.description: The reference back to a particular claim line where 0 or null is the header

attributes.name: Procedure Code
attributes.description:
24 –Principal medical procedure a patient received during inpatient stay. Coding methods for this field is International Classification of Diseases Surgical Procedures (ICD-10).
26 – Additional surgical procedure a patient received during inpatient stay. Coding methods for this field is International Classification of Diseases Surgical Procedures (ICD-10).
40 - Medical procedure  Current coding methods include: CPT-4 and HCFA Common Procedure Coding System Level II - (HCPCSII).

attributes.name: Procedure Date
attributes.description:
24- Principal medical procedure a patient received during inpatient stay. Coding methods for this field is International Classification of Diseases Surgical Procedures (ICD-10).

26 - Additional surgical procedure a patient received during inpatient stay. Coding methods for this field is International Classification of Diseases Surgical Procedures (ICD-10).

attributes.name: Procedure Type
attributes.description: Indicates whether procedure is 'principal' or 'other'

attributes.name: Modifier Code -1
attributes.description: Modifier(s) for the procedure represented on this line. Identifies special circumstances related to the performance of the service.

attributes.name: Modifier Code -2
attributes.description: Modifier(s) for the procedure represented on this line. Identifies special circumstances related to the performance of the service.

attributes.name: Modifier Code -3
attributes.description: Modifier(s) for the procedure represented on this line. Identifies special circumstances related to the performance of the service.

attributes.name: Modifier Code -4
attributes.description: Modifier(s) for the procedure represented on this line. Identifies special circumstances related to the performance of the service.

attributes.name: Days Supply
attributes.description: Number of days supply of medication dispensed by the pharmacy.

attributes.name: RX Service Reference Number
attributes.description: Identifier assigned by a payer for a claim received from a provider or subscriber. It is not the same identifier as that assigned by a provider. This identifier assigned by the payer becomes the payer's EOB identifier.

attributes.name: DAW Code
attributes.description: Prescriber's instruction regarding substitution of generic equivalents or order to dispense the specific prescribed medication.

attributes.name: Refill Number
attributes.description: The number fill of the current dispensed supply (0, 1, 2, etc.).

attributes.name: Prescription Origin Code
attributes.description: Whether the prescription was transmitted as an electronic prescription, by phone, by fax, or as a written paper copy

attributes.name: Plan Reported Brand-Generic Code
attributes.description: Whether the plan adjudicated the claim as a brand or generic drug.

attributes.name: Total Amount
attributes.description: Total amount for each category (i.e., submitted, eligible, etc.)

attributes.name: Claim Identifier Amount
attributes.description: Indicates that the claim identifier is that assigned by a payer for a claim received from a provider or subscriber.

attributes.name: Adjudication Amount Type
attributes.description: Describes the various amount fields used when payers receive and adjudicate a claim

attributes.name: Dental Claim data class
attributes.description: A collection representing a dental claim submitted to a payer for dental services rendered to a patient.

attributes.name: Dental Claim element
attributes.description: A single Dental Claim element of the Dental Claim Data Class.

attributes.name: Procedure Code
attributes.description: Dental procedure that a patient received from a health care provider. Current coding methods for reporting dental services are based on Current Dental Terminology, commonly known as CDT published by the American Dental Association (ADA).

attributes.name: Procedure Modifier Code
attributes.description: Modifier(s) for the dental procedure represented on this line. Identifies special circumstances related to the performance of the service.

attributes.name: Tooth Number - First Occurrence
attributes.description: Indicates the tooth notation i.e. the unique number or letter designated to the teeth, of the first occurrence. The values are based on the American Dental Association (ADA)'s Universal Numbering System/National Tooth Designation system for tooth numbers. (01 - 32 for permanent teeth; A – T for deciduous teeth). (01 - 32 for permanent teeth; A – T for deciduous teeth).

attributes.name: Tooth Surface
attributes.description: Indicates the specific areas of the teeth. This is based on the ADA's Universal standard mandated under HIPAA 837D.

attributes.name: Missing Tooth Number - First Occurrence
attributes.description: Indicates the first occurrence of the missing tooth number. The values are based on the American Dental Association (ADA)'s Universal Numbering System/National Tooth Designation system for tooth numbers. (01 - 32 for permanent teeth; A – T for deciduous teeth). (01 - 32 for permanent teeth; A – T for deciduous teeth).

attributes.name: Orthodontics Treatment Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates if the treatment is for orthodontics

attributes.name: Orthodontics Appliance Application Date
attributes.description: Date that the orthodontic appliances were placed.

attributes.name: Total Number of Months for Orthodontia
attributes.shortName: Total Number of Months for Orthodontia
attributes.description: Number of months the orthodontia will remain in place.

attributes.name: Prosthesis Replacement Indicator
attributes.description: Indicate whether the services billed are for an oral prosthesis such as bridges, dentures, etc.

attributes.name: Date of Prior Prosthesis Placement
attributes.description: Identify the date when the prior prosthesis was placed.

attributes.name: Tooth Number - After First Occurrence
attributes.description: Indicates the tooth notation i.e. the unique number or letter designated to the teeth, for those after the first occurrence. The values are based on the American Dental Association (ADA)'s Universal Numbering System/National Tooth Designation system for tooth numbers. (01 - 32 for permanent teeth; A – T for deciduous teeth). (01 - 32 for permanent teeth; A – T for deciduous teeth).

attributes.name: Missing Tooth Number - After First Occurrence
attributes.shortName: Missing Tooth Number - After First Occurrence
attributes.description: Indicates the missing tooth number after the first occurrence. The values are based on the American Dental Association (ADA)'s Universal Numbering System/National Tooth Designation system for tooth numbers. (01 - 32 for permanent teeth; A – T for deciduous teeth). (01 - 32 for permanent teeth; A – T for deciduous teeth).

attributes.name: Provider NPI
attributes.description: The National Provider Identifier assigned to the Provider.

attributes.name: Provider Contracting Status
attributes.description: Indicates that the Billing Provider has a contract with the Payer as of the effective date of service or admission.

attributes.name: Site of Service Network Status
attributes.description: Indicates the network status of the site of service.

attributes.name: Care Team Role
attributes.description: The functional role of a provider on a claim.

attributes.name: Provider Name
attributes.description: The name of the Attending Physician for the admission

attributes.name: Provider Address
attributes.description: The address of the facility where the service occurred.

attributes.name: Provider Payer Specific Identifier
attributes.description: Identifies the type of identifiers for practitioners

attributes.name: Provider Type
attributes.description: Type of provider:  Billing, Attending , Referring , Performing , Prescribing , Service Facility , PCP , Supervising , Operating
